episodes.synopsis: Deunan, Briareos, and the rest of the Olympus's ES.W.A.T force fend off an Argonaut attack.
episodes.title: The Nemean Lion

episodes.synopsis: Deunan and Briareos are sent to end a hostage situation on a plane with 3000 passengers. But when they arrive the entire plane is eerily empty.
episodes.title: The Augean Stables

episodes.synopsis: A surge in bioroid suicides has caused a stir throughout Olympus. Deunan steps in to investigate this mysterious situation.
episodes.title: The Ceryneian Hind

episodes.synopsis: A Kottos robot on the police force malfunctions in an unexpected way after meeting a little girl.
episodes.title: The Cattle of Geryon

episodes.synopsis: While on a security assignment, members of ES.W.A.T. are infected by something that cause madness and tremendous bloodthirst. Not even Deunan is immune to its effects.
episodes.title: The Cretan Bull

episodes.synopsis: Deunan embarks on a solo mission to infiltrate the Argonauts and learn more about an enormous and extremely high-tech Landmate.
episodes.title: The Erymanthian Boar

episodes.synopsis: As the Stymphalean Landmate approaches Olympus with a nuclear warhead, Briareos and ES.W.A.T. rush to diffuse the situation.
episodes.title: The Stymphalean Birds

episodes.synopsis: Deunan is assigned to provide security to a Poseidon ambassador of goodwill aboard a submarine. But things go awry when the submarine malfunctions and other passengers begin to die mysteriously.
episodes.title: The Mares of Diomedes

episodes.synopsis: A goodwill ambassador arrives from Poseidon... except she looks and sounds exactly like Deia, who should be dead.
episodes.title: The Girdle of Hippolyta

episodes.synopsis: Deunan and Briareos are assigned to protect a bioroid sculptor from Deia, who is bent on killing a specific group of them.
episodes.title: The Lernaean Hydra

episodes.synopsis: ES.W.A.T. is dispatched to the Argonaut to provide security for the final bioroid on Deia's hit list. Little does anyone know Deia has already made the first move.
episodes.title: The Apples of Hesperides

episodes.synopsis: Deunan and Briareos face off with Deia in a final battle.
episodes.title: The Capture of Cerberus

episodes.synopsis: Some time after the Deia incident, ES.W.A.T. is called in to supervise a diagnostic check of the Gaia Computer's systems. Soon after, unmanned Landmates and Auto Insectors start to malfunction.
episodes.title: Paradeisos
